_about: T11 Bias Auditor leakage lexicon (services/bias/auditor.py). Protected signals that are not job-relevant. Labels: a line that starts with one of them is removed. Words: masked as [PERSONAL] in running text. Placeholder-only lines (only [NAME]/[ADDRESS]/... left after anonymisation, optionally behind a label) are removed. Tuned on the dev base CVs only (false-positive check); see docs/BIAS_REPORT.md. Location is not a label here: it can be job-relevant (Remote, EU); an anonymised 'Location: [ADDRESS]' line is removed by the placeholder-only rule.
